scope: production SQLite/identity repositories; complete legacy schema74 reference-table fixture and source-context fixture; no actual old installer, network truth or audio hardware proof
cases: schema74 fixture uses the actual old closed reference definitions and retains previous audit/receipt
migration rejects unowned calls and rolls back a late table/trigger replacement fault
normal startup upgrades74to75 with exactly one verified74 snapshot and preserves every reference/audit/receipt
schema75 reopen is idempotent and does not manufacture another upgrade snapshot
track targets are separate from recording IDs and include all local file versions and printed source numbers
closed readers reject forged track context and wrong optional booleans while retaining old receipt tuple
a second track audit fault rolls back earlier references, entity audits and aggregate receipt
recording/release/two-track acceptance retains local graph/text and saves typed source context per track
offline restart replays the same aggregate command and independent track undo preserves recording/release and other track
track-only replacement retains other providers and later manual reference edit prevents old undo
foreign track ownership gained after review rejects all selected tracks without overwriting prior sources
medium disc/format changes invalidate the same track reference snapshot even when its medium ID is unchanged
schema75 backup inspection/reopen retain typed track contexts, all references and legacy/current receipts
schema75 integrity and foreign keys valid after upgrade, acceptance, compensation and conflicts
